import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam

def run(_context):
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    print(f'Document: {doc.name}')
    print(f'Document type: {doc.objectType}')
    
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    if design:
        root = design.rootComponent
        print(f'Root component: {root.name}')
        print(f'Bodies count: {root.bRepBodies.count}')
        for i in range(root.bRepBodies.count):
            body = root.bRepBodies.item(i)
            bb = body.boundingBox
            minP = bb.minPoint
            maxP = bb.maxPoint
            print(f'  Body {i}: {body.name}')
            print(f'    BBox min: ({minP.x:.3f}, {minP.y:.3f}, {minP.z:.3f}) cm')
            print(f'    BBox max: ({maxP.x:.3f}, {maxP.y:.3f}, {maxP.z:.3f}) cm')
    
    # Check for existing CAM
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    if cam:
        print(f'CAM product exists, setups: {cam.setups.count}')
    else:
        print('No CAM product yet')
    
    print(f'Units: {design.fusionUnitsManager.distanceDisplayUnits}')

    setups = cam.setups
    inp = setups.createInput(adsk.cam.OperationTypes.MillingOperation)
    
    # Set models (the body to machine)
    inp.models = [body]
    inp.name = 'Setup1 - Pocket Milling'
    
    # Set parameters
    params = inp.parameters
    
    # ---- WCS Orientation: Use model default Z up ----
    wcs_orient = params.itemByName('wcs_orientation_mode').value
    wcs_orient.value = 'modelOrientation'  # Z-up by default from model
    
    # ---- WCS Origin: Stock box point -> Top Center ----
    # Stock top center = WCS origin at top-center of stock (as specified)
    wcs_origin = params.itemByName('wcs_origin_mode').value
    wcs_origin.value = 'stockPoint'  # Stock box point
    
    wcs_box_pt = params.itemByName('wcs_origin_boxPoint').value
    wcs_box_pt.value = 'top center'  # Top center of the stock
    
    # ---- Stock: Fixed box matching part bounding box (stock = part) ----
    # Part BBox: 100x100x50mm -> in cm: 10x10x5
    # Stock matches the bounding box - 0 offset
    stock_mode = params.itemByName('job_stockMode').value
    stock_mode.value = 'fixedbox'  # Fixed size box
    
    # Stock offset = 0 (stock matches part exactly)
    stock_offset_mode = params.itemByName('job_stockOffsetMode').value
    stock_offset_mode.value = 'keep'  # No additional stock
    
    # Fixed stock dimensions in cm: 10x10x5 cm (100x100x50 mm)
    # These will be computed from the model bounding box when offset=0
    # Set stock offset to 0
    stock_offset_p = params.itemByName('job_stockOffset')
    if stock_offset_p:
        stock_offset_p.value.value = 0.0
    
    # Add the setup
    setup = setups.add(inp)
    if setup:
        print(f'Setup created: {setup.name}')
        print(f'Setup valid: {setup.isValid}')
        print(f'Setup active: {setup.isActive}')

    print(f'Rough tool: {rough_tool.description}')
    rough_preset = rough_tool.presets.item(0)
    print(f'Rough preset: {rough_preset.name}')
    
    # ============================================================
    # OPERATION 1: Adaptive Clearing (Pocket Roughing)
    # ============================================================
    # The pocket:
    #   - Located centered on XY, 60x60mm, 20mm deep
    #   - Stock top = Z=0 (WCS), pocket floor at Z=-20mm (in WCS)
    #   - In Fusion cm units: WCS origin at top of stock
    #   - Body goes from Z=0 (top) to Z=-5cm (bottom in model coords)
    #   - BBox from face data: body top at z=5cm, bottom at z=0
    #   - Stock top (WCS Z=0) = body z=5cm
    #   - Pocket floor at Z=-2cm in WCS (20mm below stock top)
    #   NOTE: WCS Z=0 is stock top, negative Z goes into the part
    
    op_inp = ops.createInput('adaptive')
    op_inp.displayName = 'Adaptive Clearing - Pocket Rough'
    op_inp.tool = rough_tool
    op_inp.toolPreset = rough_preset
    
    params = op_inp.parameters
    
    # --- HEIGHTS ---
    # Clearance height: 10mm above stock top
    ch_mode = params.itemByName('clearanceHeight_mode').value
    ch_mode.value = 'from stock top'
    params.itemByName('clearanceHeight_offset').value.value = 1.0  # 1cm = 10mm above stock top
    
    # Retract height: 5mm above stock top  
    rh_mode = params.itemByName('retractHeight_mode').value
    rh_mode.value = 'from stock top'
    params.itemByName('retractHeight_offset').value.value = 0.5  # 0.5cm = 5mm above stock top
    
    # Top height: stock top (Z=0 WCS)
    th_mode = params.itemByName('topHeight_mode').value
    th_mode.value = 'from stock top'
    params.itemByName('topHeight_offset').value.value = 0.0
    
    # Bottom height: 20mm below stock top = pocket floor
    # = -2cm in WCS (from stock top, offset -2cm)
    bh_mode = params.itemByName('bottomHeight_mode').value
    bh_mode.value = 'from stock top'
    params.itemByName('bottomHeight_offset').value.value = -2.0  # -2cm = 20mm below stock top
    
    # --- PASSES ---
    # Optimal load (radial engagement): 50% of diameter = 0.5cm
    params.itemByName('optimalLoad').value.value = 0.5  # 0.5cm = 5mm
    
    # Maximum stepdown: 0.8cm = 8mm
    params.itemByName('maximumStepdown').value.value = 0.8  # 0.8cm = 8mm
    
    # Stock to leave: 0.3mm = 0.03cm (for finishing pass)
    params.itemByName('useStockToLeave').value.value = True
    params.itemByName('stockToLeave').value.value = 0.03  # 0.3mm
    params.itemByName('verticalStockToLeave').value.value = 0.03  # 0.3mm on floor
    
    # Direction: Climb milling (conventional for aluminum)
    dir_p = params.itemByName('direction').value
    dir_p.value = 'climb'
    
    # Ramp entry (helix)
    params.itemByName('doRamp').value.value = True
    ramp_type = params.itemByName('rampType').value
    ramp_type.value = 'helical'
    params.itemByName('rampAngle').value.value = 2.0  # 2 degree helix
    
    # Add operation
    rough_op = ops.add(op_inp)
    if rough_op:

    root = design.rootComponent
    body = root.bRepBodies.item(0)

    # First delete the existing failing floor and wall ops
    # (item 1 and 2 - after deletion we'll recreate)
    wall_op = ops.item(2)
    floor_op = ops.item(1)
    
    wall_op.deleteMe()
    floor_op.deleteMe()
    print(f'After delete, ops count: {ops.count}')
    
    # Now let's look at the pocket floor face
    # From face data: Face 5 is the pocket floor (z=3cm = 30mm from base = 20mm below top)
    # area 35.7854 cm2, min/max z = 3cm (floor)
    print(f'\nBody faces:')
    for i in range(body.faces.count):
        face = body.faces.item(i)
        bb = face.boundingBox
        minZ = bb.minPoint.z
        maxZ = bb.maxPoint.z
        if abs(minZ - 3.0) < 0.01 and abs(maxZ - 3.0) < 0.01:  # floor at z=3cm
            print(f'  POCKET FLOOR - Face {i}: area={face.area:.4f} cm2')

            print(f'  POCKET WALL - Face {i}: area={face.area:.4f} cm2, z={minZ:.2f}-{maxZ:.2f}')
